title: Clan armies
changes: The clan that holds a land now marches a column of eight soldiers, two abreast, from its Hold past its standards. An officer leads with the clan pennant.
A few guards stand watch around every Hold. A weakly held land keeps a smaller column and fewer guards.
When a siege is called, a real battle breaks out at each standard: lines of both clans trade blows, some fall, and reinforcements walk in. It is only for show: they cannot be fought.
